description_en: Queries the logs of a Spark application
name: GetSparkAppLog

parameters.help_en:
The Spark application ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612475.html operation to query the Spark application ID
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612475.html接口查询Spark应用的ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The number of log entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 300
parameters.help_zh: 日志的行数。取值范围为1~500，默认值为300
parameters.name: log_length

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html接口查看目标地域下所有集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

DBClusterId.description_en: The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition cluster
DBClusterId.description_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>

LogContent.example: 22/04/22 15:30:49 INFO Utils: Start the dump task because s202206061441hz22a35ab000****-0001 app end, the interval is 238141ms;22/04/22 15:30:49 INFO AbstractConnector: Stopped Spark@5e774d9d{HTTP/1.1, (http/1.1)}{0.0.0.0:4040}
LogContent.title_en: spark app的日志内容, 如配置了重试则为最后一次重试的尾部日志内容.
LogContent.title_zh: spark app的日志内容, 如配置了重试则为最后一次重试的尾部日志内容.

LogSize.description_en: The number of log entries. A value of 0 indicates that no valid logs are returned
LogSize.description_zh: 日志的行数，0代表没有有效日志

Message.description_en: The alert message returned for the request, such as task execution failure or insufficient resources. If no alert occurs, null is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回告警信息，如任务执行失败或资源不足等，无告警时则返回为空
Message.example: WARNING:  log file maybe deleted, please check oss path: oss://TestBucketName/applog/
